title: The Fullest Moon of Spring
skyStory: One hundred percent. The moon is completely, gloriously full, blazing in Sagittarius like an archer's target lit from within. Sagittarius is the wanderer, the one with a backpack always half-packed. Tonight the moon wants to go somewhere, anywhere, and it's calling every road in Atlantic Canada to come along. Mars has the map. Saturn has the snacks. Nobody has a plan, and that is the plan.

reading: A fire moon for a fire sign, and the Tiger is fully awake. You'll feel the itch to go somewhere new, even if it's just a different trail, a new coffee spot, a road you've never turned down. Turn down it. The Sagittarius moon rewards curiosity with tiny surprises.

But the [[Knight of Wands]] has one note: aim. Pick one direction and go all the way, instead of five half-trips. Tonight, set the onyx in the moonlight again, at the same hour Nancy's ruby faces the sky. The moon is fullest now, and the Full Moon Recharge works best when the two of you are thinking of each other at once.
joel.mission: Take a road, path or hallway you've never taken before and report the most surprising thing you find.
joel.omen: An arrow painted on pavement pointing somewhere unexpected. Follow your gut; it's aiming true tonight.
joel.stoneWhy: a second night in the moonlight
joel.elementWhy: fire moon, fire sign, Fire Tiger

reading: The full moon is fattest tonight and it's shining straight down on your path like a spotlight that finally got the cue right. Something you've worked toward quietly for months gets a moment of recognition. Small, maybe, but unmistakable.

[[The Sun]] reversed asks you to stop earning the joy and just allow it. When someone says well done, the correct response is a grin, not a list of everything you still need to fix. Then the ruby goes back on the windowsill for one more night of moon charging. Tomorrow it'll glow a little brighter on your pinky.
nancy.mission: When someone praises you today, respond only with a grin and the word yes. Nothing else. See how it feels.
nancy.omen: A balloon floating free in the sky. Something you've been holding tight wants to rise; let it.
nancy.stoneWhy: one more night under the full moon

together.text: The moon is completely full. Set the ruby and onyx out once more and step outside at 9:45, wherever you are. Raise one hand to the moon like you're toasting it. It's the fullest it will be all spring, and it came out just for you two.
